India's Polio Vaccination Efforts Emphasize Continued Surveillance

India's ongoing efforts to maintain its polio-free status require a dual approach of vaccination and continued surveillance. Public health messaging highlights the importance of ensuring children's polio vaccination schedules are up to date to prevent the resurgence of the disease.
